ten: Xu hướng chỉ số Mỹ (chỉ thị phiên)

hedge.tran_keo: <= 2%/nam (CAGR to hop tru CAGR core, neu am)
hedge.chuan_pass: Danh gia tren danh muc core long US100/US500 + hedge. To hop cai thien DD va/hoac Sharpe so voi core long-only, CAGR tuong duong hoac tot hon sau phi XM (ke ca financing short), keo hedge <= 2%/nam. Tien dang ky, OOS 2016+, BH-FDR. Hedge khong can lai khi dung mot.

chuan: Core long: phai thang mua-va-giu cung rui ro/pho nhiem (Sharpe hon, hoac cung lai + DD thap hon), sau phi XM, OOS 2016+ nhin mot lan, tien dang ky + BH-FDR. Lai rong, DD toi da 80%, >=10%/nam, vao lenh theo luat. Hedge/short: danh gia nhu overlay tren core (khong can lai dung mot). To hop phai cai thien DD va/hoac Sharpe, CAGR khong kem hon core qua 2%/nam (tran keo), cung phi XM 2 chieu, tien dang ky + BH-FDR.
